thread:
eva_support: Heads up — multiple customers flagging that the A/B rollout dashboard for feature `smart-pricing` shows variants flipped and assignment counts wildly off. Staging + prod. Screenshot: https://s3.redwood/example/smart-pricing-metrics.png :warning:

matt_engineer: Can you paste repro steps + one request id or user id where counts differ?

eva_support: Quick repro: in the console -> Experiments -> smart-pricing -> 'Assignments' tab. Dashboard shows variant labels 'control'=75% and 'experiment'=25% for yesterday, but raw events table shows the opposite. Sample user: uid_73421, request_id=req_20240317_9. I ran a quick SQL: ```SELECT variant_label, count(distinct user_id) as users FROM analytics.assignments WHERE rollout='smart-pricing' AND event_date='2026-02-25' GROUP BY 1;``` Result on dashboard: control 3,014 / experiment 1,020. Event store: control 980 / experiment 3,050.

dan_dataeng: That's a big discrepancy. Two quick checks: 1) are we joining on the right key when mapping variant_key -> variant_label in the dashboard query? 2) is there any recent migration that changed variant_index ordering?

matt_engineer: Pushed to investigate. Dashboard query used by the console (simplified) is: ```-- dashboard service mapping
SELECT m.variant_label, count(distinct a.user_id) AS users
FROM assignments a
JOIN rollout_metadata m ON m.rollout_id = a.rollout_id AND m.variant_index = a.variant_index
WHERE a.rollout_id = 'smart-pricing' AND a.event_date = '2026-02-25'
GROUP BY 1;
```

dan_dataeng: There's the problem — rollout_metadata.variant_index was recently deprecated in favor of variant_key (string). A migration last week populated variant_key but variant_index is no longer guaranteed to match ordering. The UI should join on variant_key.

lisa_pm: Oh no — this explains why customers saw reversed labels. Any chance this also affected funnel/quality dashboards tied to the same mapping? :eyes:

matt_engineer: Likely. We'll need a hotfix to the dashboard-service to change the JOIN to `ON m.rollout_id = a.rollout_id AND m.variant_key = a.variant_key` and a short data backfill for corrupted reports. Temporary mitigation: hide per-variant labels and show raw variant_key counts.

eva_support: Can we flip a config flag so console shows variant_key instead of label until fix? Customers are asking for an update.

matt_engineer: Yes — adding a feature-flagged fallback now. Patch: https://git.redwood/repo/dashboard-service/commit/8f3a... (patching join). Deploying to prod-standby first.

deploy-bot: deploy dashboard-service v2.14.3-hotfix (commit 8f3a...) started to prod-standby at 2026-03-17T14:02:11Z.

dan_dataeng: I ran a quick reconciliation after switching a local join to variant_key; counts match event store now. New query: ```SELECT a.variant_key, count(distinct a.user_id) as users FROM assignments a WHERE rollout_id='smart-pricing' AND event_date='2026-02-25' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY users DESC; -- result: v_exp 3050, v_ctrl 980```

matt_engineer: Hotfix deployed to prod-standby and flagged in console. Rolling to prod in 10m if no regression. Will also open a backfill job to recompute dashboard aggregates for the last 7 days.

lisa_pm: Good. Please send a brief customer-facing note I can forward to affected accounts.

eva_support: Draft for customers: "We're investigating inaccurate variant labels and counts in the Experiments dashboard for smart-pricing. We've identified a mapping bug and rolled a temporary fix — counts should now reflect raw variant keys. We're running a backfill to recalculate historical aggregates and will follow up when complete. Apologies for the noise." Approve? :thumbsup:

matt_engineer: Approve. Adding steps to postmortem: record the migration that deprecated variant_index, add schema alerts, unit-test the dashboard join logic, and enable a nightly job to validate label<>key mapping.

deploy-bot: deploy to prod completed at 2026-03-17T14:10:05Z. No errors.

dan_dataeng: Backfill job submitted: job_id=backfill-20260317-01, will recompute aggregates for rollout 'smart-pricing' for last 7 days. ETA ~ 22m.

eva_support: Noted and updating customers. Thanks all. :pray:
